output.summary: A genus of tall biennial and perennial herbs native to temperate and subarctic regions of the Northern Hemisphere. They have large, twice-divided leaves and broad clusters of white or greenish-white flowers whose scents vary by species and even subspecies.
output.edibilityNote: Some species are foods: candied young A. archangelica stems and leaf midribs are eaten, while A. lucida is eaten like wild celery.
